| Item | Low (dB) | High (dB) |

| waveguide attenuation | 0.01 | 0.05 |
| rubbing in holes | 0.00 | 1.00 |
| cold end greased | 0.00 | 3.00 |
| **total, tier A (greased tip)** | **1.0** | **8.0** |
| total, tier B (dry tip at 500 °C) | 12.0 | 31.7 |
| the rod-end route (checks.json) | 26.3 | 52.3 |
| the previous waveguide budget (with an end-cap seal and a sensor shoe) | 3.2 | 9.1 |

Method: contacts as normal springs between two rods of the waveguide's impedance (mech_monitoring check 6): a Hertz dome plus the couplant film round it (dk = K dA / h, h = h0 + r^2/2R out to the head's edge); the flat cold end as a film K A / h; impedance step Al/316 at normal incidence; attenuation 0.1-0.5 dB/m. couplant film: bulk modulus ~1 GPa for a PFPE or silicone grease (assumed); minimum film 1 um (the surfaces' roughness); a flat greased joint at 10-20 N squeezes to 2-10 um (assumed).
